portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.  

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use 
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
xorg-x11-drv-i810 provides a driver for Intel integrated graphics chips for
the X.org implementation of the X Window System.

This release adds support for the following new chipsets:

* 945GME

* 965GM

* 965GME

* G33

* Q33

* Q35

All users should install this newly released package, which adds these
enhancements.
